scientific_integrity: All-dimensional proof based on incidence rank, affine-dependency decomposition, simplex and join reflection. Independent external evaluation has not been performed. The included finite checker is corroborative and not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Proved for connected finite simple cactus graphs with at least two edges and an orientation balanced on every undirected cycle; zero-dimensional, non-cactus and non-semi-balanced cases are outside scope. Published-source searches do not establish global priority.
title: Exact Minkowski asymmetry and unique centers of semi-balanced cactus root polytopes
